summary: Elevated 5xx rate for large-embedding uploads caused by edge->runtime stream resets and retry amplification
description:
Issue summary:
Customer NucleusAI reports a sharp increase in 5xx errors when performing bulk embedding uploads (~50-200 requests/min per tenant) starting 2026-03-12 18:12 UTC. Errors surface as HTTP 502/503 from the API gateway and occasional 524s observed by the customer. Initial evidence points to an unstable handoff between edge ingress and the serving runtime; several edge-initiated stream resets coincide with client retry storms which amplify upstream load.

Impact:
- Affects only one dedicated tenant cluster (NucleusAI) in us-east until 2026-03-12 18:40 UTC, then partial spillover increased error-rate for other tenants on the same edge pool.
- Customer reports 18% failure rate for large embedding batch uploads (payloads >5MB) and elevated latency on successful requests.
- Customer-facing SLA at risk; active support engagement required.

Observed behavior / timeline:
- 18:12 UTC: Customer begins large-embedding batch job.
- 18:13–18:20 UTC: API gateway metrics show 5xx rate rising from baseline 0.3% to ~12%.
- 18:17 UTC: Edge logs record HTTP/2 GOAWAY and RST_STREAM events correlating with tenant requests.
- 18:19 UTC: Runtime reports transient "stream hang" warnings and accepts fewer new sessions; some worker processes return SIGPIPE before restart.
- 18:25 UTC: Customer retries cause observed retry amplification pattern (client retry after 502), increasing concurrent sessions and evicting prefix/KV cache entries.

Notes on constraints:
- Occurs primarily for large-payload multipart requests using HTTP/2. Small embedding single-request flows are largely unaffected.
- Dedicated tenant has custom routing rules and a pinned model variant; runtime config shows aggressive keepalive and short idle timeouts.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) In dedicated tenant us-east, start a large-embedding bulk upload (50+ items, total payload >5MB) over HTTP/2.
2) Configure client to retry on 5xx with exponential backoff (typical SDK default).
3) Observe API gateway 5xx rate and ingress-proxy RST_STREAM/GOAWAY logs.
4) Check runtime process logs for stream handoff warnings and worker SIGPIPE/restarts.

investigation_notes: 18:30 UTC - Omar: Correlated ingress-proxy RST_STREAM events with elevated 5xx; initial suspicion is client-triggered retry amplification causing queue saturation.
18:45 UTC - Eng (SRE) attached flamegraph; runtime worker CPU shows user-space stalls during large payload deserialization (protobuf processing).

19:05 UTC - Engineering hypothesis: combination of short keepalive/idle timeouts at edge + large payload processing increases request latency; client retries hit edge which RSTs/GOAWAY in backlog leading to upstream SIGPIPEs.
19:40 UTC - Confirmed that multipart parsing code path in runtime blocks event loop for large payloads under load (PR referenced below).
comments: 2026-03-12 18:25 - Maya (Support): Escalated to SRE after initial log triage; customer on the line and seeing 20% failures for large batches.
2026-03-12 18:37 - Athena (SRE): Spun up an extra serving pool for the tenant; transient drop in 5xx observed but not full mitigation.
2026-03-12 19:10 - Omar (Oncall Eng): Identified PR with potential fix for non-blocking parsing: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4223. Planning hotfix if validation passes.
2026-03-12 20:00 - Support (Maya): Provided customer a temporary workaround to limit batch size to <5MB and disable aggressive client retries while we validate fix.
resolution_notes: Mitigation steps applied: temporary scaling of tenant serving pool and customer advised to reduce batch size and relax client retry policy. Engineering prepared a non-blocking parsing hotfix (PR #4223). Next steps: validate hotfix in staging, perform a canary rollout to affected dedicated cluster, and update runtime keepalive defaults and ingress backpressure thresholds to reduce handoff fragility. Postmortem will include recommended SDK guidance for exponential backoff jitter and a change to default idle_timeouts for dedicated tenants.
next_steps: Validate runtime non-blocking parsing PR in staging (assigned Omar)
Canary roll hotfix to one us-east edge pool (SRE)
Update embedding upload docs with recommended batch size limits (Docs)
Create follow-up INT ticket to adjust keepalive/idle defaults for dedicated clusters
